entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 provides a universal memory layer for AI agents, with separate memory states for users, sessions, and agents. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as an OSS SDK, a self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight gives agents retain, recall, and reflect operations for long-term memory. It offers Python, Node.js/TypeScript, and Go clients, and supports multiple LLM providers, including local options.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking stores knowledge, memories, and skills in a virtual filesystem, with directory-scoped search and browsing. As an official Hermes Agent memory provider, it offers tiered L0 abstracts, L1 overviews, and L2 details.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee builds connected memory from documents, code, and conversations for agents that need persistent memory across sessions. It supports local text processing without an LLM and includes a CLI for remembering and recalling text.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory extracts facts and handles updates, contradictions, and forgetting. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider with connectors for services including Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub, plus plugins, an MCP server, and JavaScript and Python API clients.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections and withdrawal. It offers keyword and optional semantic retrieval and synthesis, and can share memory across agents.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho stores messages and events on sessions, then reasons in the background to update peer representations. It is the upstream library used by the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper and is available as a managed service, local CLI, or self-hosted FastAPI server.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git repo, managing a plain Markdown context tree with commit, branch, and merge operations. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider with five retrieval tiers, four of them non-LLM, and includes an interactive TUI and REPL.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes agents with one pure-Python dependency. It integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK; its README reports BEAM results for v3.0.0 and marks LongMemEval as pending.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto consolidates memories, reconciles conflicting information, and briefs agents with relevant memories before they act. It supports importing and exporting through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS organizes Hermes Agent memory into seven layers, including vector search and structured facts, with an auto-curated wiki. It uses local infrastructure and a Ground Truth hierarchy to help ensure the agent prioritizes injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext runs agent tasks against evaluations, keeps useful lessons, and discards dead ends. It also leaves traces, reports, and playbooks, making it a context harness for agents working on complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Hermes Agent plugin uses a SQLite store and hierarchical DAG to persist messages, with the stated goal of never losing a message. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from stored context.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: deja-vu searches months of existing session history across supported coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, and OpenClaw. It offers a terminal interface for searching and resuming sessions and runs locally without a model, embeddings, or server.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted Honcho memory backend for private cross-session persistence with Hermes Agent. It supports OpenAI-compatible LLM providers or local inference servers, and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: SignetAI provides a local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer with portable state across Hermes Agent and other agent harnesses. It can import files, webpages, and agent conversations, and includes a dashboard for browsing memory and sources.
entries.plur-ai/plur: plur stores shared agent memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk, using an open format for multi-agent systems. It offers local search after a one-time model download, with keyword fallback; its README reports 95.6% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (N=500).
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context and memory engine that combines BM25, vector search, rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, with integrations through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system with a five-tier hierarchical schema backed by SQLite and FTS5 search. Its five-package family includes an SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and LangGraph BaseStore, without a vector database or embedding model.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering to support prefix-cache sharing, including for text and multimodal context. Its context index supports reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling, and it integrates with Hermes Agent as well as vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This Hermes memory plugin uses an embedded backend by default, so it does not require a separate server. Recall results include a why_retrieved reason, and the plugin supports duplicate canonicalization and contradiction tracking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: agentcairn stores durable, cross-project memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata, keeping an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. It uses a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and retrieval, and connects to coding agents through MCP servers and host-specific plugins.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: llm-wiki-cli is an agent-driven CLI for recalling, maintaining, and evolving persistent knowledge across sessions. It builds a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history without requiring embeddings or a vector database.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: flowstate-qmd uses an anticipatory cache that watches agent session logs to prefetch context. It combines local SQLite-vec storage with GGUF models via node-llama-cpp and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack brings Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace together under one memory owner for Hermes Agent. It prepares a purpose-built evidence packet for each query, using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma for state and retrieval management.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep combines semantic search with BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal to make stored information easier to find. It also indexes codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, while edge tags link notes in navigable, bidirectional relationships.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema tokens through local keyword-based ranking and supports Tool Search. It integrates as middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19 and later, and includes a dashboard for monitoring savings and managing tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides Git-backed Markdown context and workflows for Claude Code, Codex, and compatible coding agents. Its first-class adapters support multiple agents, while reviewed handoffs use hash-checked proposals and receipts.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes memory plugin stores data in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships. Its importance-weighted recall surfaces higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources for capability search and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, along with session and pre-LLM-call hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes AgentMemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with on-demand summarization and an audit trace of prefetch operations in trace.jsonl. It supports immediate event deletion, so deleted events are not retained as persistent summaries.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind recovers the original goal from the first user turn of a long Claude Code or Codex session. It offers goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes, skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and uses neither a summarizing model nor an external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys, making it a payment-focused option in this list.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: The XMemo plugin provides durable cross-session memory for Hermes Agent with semantic search, using lifecycle hooks for pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots. A local SQLite layer supports caching and write-outbox reliability, and the plugin can read memories from other connected agents.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It offers tools to search and manually store memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, including semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A. It supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop, and includes commands for repository sync and indexed Git-history search.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. It supports native Rust FFI or HTTP daemon execution and combines HNSW approximate-nearest-neighbor, sparse, and FM-index retrieval.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides Hermes memory tools for managing memories and traversing knowledge graphs. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can checkpoint context automatically during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit is a file-based memory-curation loop that works with Markdown and produces JSON diffs for review, without a database. Its rot and lint curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert memory changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers provides composable skills with instructions designed to make agents use them, plus a software-development workflow that moves from specification and design sign-off through planning and subagent execution. It belongs in a skills list for teams seeking a defined development methodology, with installation documented separately for multiple harnesses.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first design and prototyping system that brings together skills, design templates, design systems, and plugins. Its support for multiple coding agents—including Hermes Agent—through skills, CLI, MCP, or runtime adapters makes it a design-focused option in this list.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository offers structured cybersecurity skills across security domains, with mappings to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3. Its breadth and compatibility with more than 26 AI platforms make it a framework-oriented choice for security work.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Drawio-skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations, while the diagramctl CLI and optional MCP server provide ways to use it.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet Court combines a master router and connector skills with vendored copies of official protocol skills. It adds verification and dispute resolution, setting it apart as a skill for agent-to-agent commerce workflows.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid AI Writing can detect patterns, rewrite text, or edit prose in place, with optional casual, professional, technical, warm, and blunt profiles. Its command-line detector also works with files and piped text, making it a focused writing and editing skill.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw uses background evolution to deduplicate skills and improve their quality, and unifies skill libraries across agents, devices, and team members. Its integrations include Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills for Claude Code, Codex, and agents compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It also maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection provides professional agent skills as plain Markdown files, with README-listed tasks such as writing PRDs and decoding leases. An installer copies the skill text files, and uninstalling removes them.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: YouTube-skills covers transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor. Use requires a TranscriptAPI key, which has a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes Skill Factory watches active workflows for reusable patterns and can generate both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds. Slash commands let users manage, list, and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super-Hermes generates custom thinking instructions for specific tasks and includes pre-built analytical lenses for different domains. It reports findings alongside potential blind spots in the analysis.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, including remote skill registries sourced from Git and S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and script execution, with sandboxing to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, and a review gate evaluates specs with PASS/FAIL models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Creates .lit.md documents that weave prose, diagrams, and source code, then extracts runnable files from them with a tangler. It also syncs source-file edits back into the literate document, making it suited to workflows where code and documentation evolve together.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running AI agents, with SQLite storage and event logging through a mechanism kernel. It coordinates agent teams using the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes and skills.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Shares memory across instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Supports the Brazilian Hermes Agent community with Portuguese-language skills in SKILL.md format and guides for installation, configuration, and use. The project also describes contributions through forks and pull requests.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides prompting guidance for FLUX image and video generation alongside BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. Its FLUX 3 video suite includes eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills that follow the Agent Skills spec and can be installed with `npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills`. The README describes the repository as containing community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agent instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse, with both automated and step-by-step workflows. It also supports skill testing and export.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika describes itself as a workflow language for AI with one file, four verbs, and one Rust binary. It checks workflows before calling a model, runs with a model of your choice, and verifies each run’s tamper-evident record.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with a Python client and CLI. Its installation process resolves dependencies recursively, and it includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures provide a path to recover from problems.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This Hermes Agent skill manages Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for validating credentials and configuring access.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub is a community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills, with federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification and runs continuously via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye narrows the skills presented before LLM calls using five retrieval layers, including hard triggers, full-text search, synonyms, and semantic embeddings. It can degrade gracefully when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is an ADHD-friendly personal execution system for habits and study blocks, with agent-driven scheduling and system design through an MCP connection. It stores data in a single local SQLite file and includes a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs read-only adversarial code review, using parallel subagents to examine edge cases, integrations, and other potential issues. It combines deterministic scans with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill simplifies code with three parallel agents focused on Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust, and uses a tiered application process with an approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize for Hermes adapts verified procedures for breaking tasks into multiple stories, with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It also provides an investigation protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, plus a Python goal engine for persistent task state.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This project provides a cybersecurity lab for Hermes Agent, with skills and tools for network, forensics, and exploitation work. Its highlights include more than 2,077 skills across repositories, 131+ tools, and integrations with 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: Skillsdotnet implements agentskills.io in C# and .NET, using SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and can automatically register common agent skill directories.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is a local, read-only observability dashboard that tracks token costs, session history, and skill analytics in real time. It applies local log desensitization and offers optional incident alerts through Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides plain-markdown agent skills for code review and session management, including multi-session reconciliation and worktree recovery. Skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill creates reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs, generating either VHS tape files or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries, and optimizes GIFs to target sizes under 8 MB.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server searches more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, then provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins. Its support for MCP-compatible clients including Hermes makes it a discovery tool for agents in this list.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This project builds Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes. It also monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field changes.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic feedback loop analyzes session history to identify skill coverage gaps and draft improvement proposals. Updates are gated by deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators, and the project runs locally using Python’s standard library without daemons or external services.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These Hermes Agent skills route file operations using path syntax suited to native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, or WSL. They also select and verify existing project-compatible Python interpreters without installing one.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides agent skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment, with support for Claude Code, Cursor, and other agentskills.io-compliant clients. It also includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection includes skills to transcribe Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, remove common Chinese AI-writing patterns with a rule-based engine, and extract structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. It brings video, text, and document workflows together for Hermes Agent.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This Hermes Agent plugin lets agents browse open support bounties, purchase ticket context, and submit answers for human review; public wallet earnings records are available. Users can also create a bounty board, which returns a URL, API key, and USDC deposit addresses.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses and supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal tests AI agent skills for structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It produces Ed25519-signed certificates and provides a public API for certificate verification and skill submission.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server that exposes 191 tools. The project also includes five workflow skills and supports Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This Hermes Agent skill generates structured Chinese news briefings at geographic scales ranging from global to street level. Reports include core conclusions and action suggestions, and semantic memory uses user interests to expand searches.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This MCP server provides deterministic Western and Vedic astrology results using JPL DE440, with no LLM involved and SHA-256 hashes for verification. Its no-auth MCP endpoint and per-call x402 or MPP payments make it a distinct agent skill for astrology queries.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: This remote MCP offers token-risk checks and prediction-market slippage data for AI agents. MCP discovery and two onboarding tools are free, while most other tool calls require x402 payment.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token usage, with server metadata and tool schemas discovered incrementally. Its socket-based daemon architecture supports persistent connections, making it a distinct option for Hermes agents that need MCP access.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project packages AI coding agents and development tools for Nix, including Hermes. Its packages are automatically updated daily, and the README lists Nix run commands for the available tools.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. Its highlights include an ARM64 Android installer for Antigravity CLI, OpenClaw configuration guides, and hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This Termux-based installer and guide runs Hermes Agent on Android using a proot-distro Ubuntu setup. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell commands, and external providers or local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with single-writer state-safety guardrails for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It offers direct deployment or operator-ready CRD workflows, plus configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also supports Telegram voice and file messaging, and scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent in a sandbox with hardware-enforced controls through NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and provides configurable security policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes, with REST, CLI, and MCP interfaces. Its listed features include a 69-entry credential catalog, 17+ LLM provider integrations, and AES-256-GCM secret encryption with mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image for Hermes Agent that includes mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and building specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module supports reproducible Hermes deployment with declarative configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It combines Nix-managed and CLI-installed skill management, and supports secrets integration through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for operating multiple Hermes Agent instances from one web application, with separate workspaces and identities for each. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular tool, path, and network permission policies.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable Hermes Agent package that runs from a USB or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals rescue tools for offline use.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project sets up Hermes Gateway as a headless, reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian servers, with Nous Portal integration. It also supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents applies a multi-agent framework to financial trading: fundamental analysts assess company financials and performance metrics, while sentiment analysts aggregate news headlines, StockTwits, and Reddit chatter. Selected analysts work in parallel using their own tools, bringing different kinds of analysis to the trading process.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides a self-hosted interface for governing agent registration, task dispatch, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It supports multi-agent workflows through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires is a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and other named agent tools. It keeps sessions running in the background with tmux and offers sandboxing plus dashboards with diff review.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This Control Room-first template describes a path from a single Hermes Agent on one VPS to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture uses a task bus for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation and handoffs, and includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: SwarmClaw is for building autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts show how agent teams are delegated, setting it apart as a swarm-oriented option.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions offers a single-screen mission control for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. Its Kanban board tracks task status and review queues, while live streams show agent reasoning and tool execution; proposed task completions require human verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A strict pipeline architecture and Master Orchestrator handle routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for collaboration between Leader and Specialist agents, managing an automated task lifecycle. It uses MCP and ACP for local tool and communication handling, with a real-time web UI for agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It runs TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations and provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator stages two competing AI companies, orchestrating nine autonomous agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning. A real-time dashboard displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel implements a local Mixture-of-Agents stack by querying models in parallel and synthesizing their outputs, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, with stated optimization for RTX 4080/5080 hardware and no cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a full project knowledge graph with `codegraph init`, including structural extraction and cross-file resolution for supported languages. It connects to multiple coding agents through MCP, giving Hermes Agent and other agents pre-indexed code context intended to reduce token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI for tracking token usage and costs across Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, and other AI coding agents. It reads data from each client's local storage paths and can submit usage to a leaderboard and public profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude-tap records coding-agent API traffic for local inspection, with support for tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor CLI. It exports trace sessions to a self-contained HTML viewer and redacts common authentication headers before recording.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor tracks token usage, costs, and rate limits across more than 45 AI coding tools, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Codex. Its widget also shows historical trends and usage breakdowns, with syncing across multiple devices.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build user interfaces. It works with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot, and is compatible with AI providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes adds an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes skills for product briefs, design handoffs, and implementation, plus seven agents spanning product-lifecycle roles; its GitHub integration can enable issue and pull request delivery.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins is a community CLI for customizing the Hermes terminal UI, including banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. YAML-based configuration supports creating themes, with examples ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a command-line static linter for AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts, using HERM v1.1 scoring. It scans prompts, tool definitions, schemas, and agent files, then reports findings with specific fixes and supported line references.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging using the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable @handles. It also facilitates commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows, and includes a supervisor sidebar for managing agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, where it runs natively without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages organized into permanent knowledge graph and session cache tiers. Its Claude Code plugin can automatically capture and recall context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for token-saving CLI workflows, with a stated 90–99% token savings. It also includes 40+ pre-configured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, plus automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that use folder-local configuration and skills. It supports switching between default and scoped agents, with project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This project automates installation of hermes-agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers OpenClaw files—including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives—to Hermes. It also maps configuration and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco is a self-healing observability plugin for AI agents that exports real-time telemetry from Hermes conversations. It offers passive analysis and scheduled active probing, with config-aware baselines to detect performance drift after local file changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: Hermes Voice adds voice interaction with an open mic and wake word, and runs offline without API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, along with adaptive turn-taking and barge-in.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes Startup is designed to help users pursue online opportunities, using a deterministic, zero-network local runtime by default. It requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes, and includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: Hermes Memoss is a memory plugin that supports semantic search and multi-dimensional memory storage. It provides tools to search, add, and delete memories, and includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC-Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent tools, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs. Alongside a built-in agent with file access, web search, and MCP tools, it offers 21 ready-to-use assistants and runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI brings Hermes Agent to the web and phone through a three-panel interface for sessions, chat, and workspace files. Its workspace file browser includes inline previews, and the project is built with Python and vanilla JavaScript without a build step.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a desktop companion for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools, and the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a web dashboard for Hermes Agent with multi-platform chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and channel configuration for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It also supports shared and group chats, visual workflows, persistent sessions, and tools for files, voice, devices, and agent management; desktop apps are available for Windows, macOS, and Linux, as are npm and Docker options.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace combines chat, a terminal, memory and skills managers, an MCP catalog, and an inspector in a web workspace. Its Swarm Mode provides role-based dispatch with tmux-backed workers, while the workspace includes a file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that brings sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other agents together in a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, then delegate with @ or queue tasks in separate worktrees; it includes 15 agents and supports ACP agents.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace connects directly to Hermes hosts locally or over SSH and presents sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs in dedicated views. Its embedded terminal provides direct shell access for tasks such as system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first Chinese desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS and native window and process management. It includes a Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health-check and update capabilities, plus interfaces for chat, memory management, and LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local, cloud, or self-hosted remote Hermes gateway. Users can attach page context, files, or staged screenshots, while Chromium-only Hermes Control can operate tabs.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone client for driving a self-hosted Hermes agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It requires iOS 18 or later; users run the server, and the app is free with no analytics or tracking.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. Its runtime dashboard tracks token usage and latency, while a live workspace shows code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for monitoring Hermes. It tracks agent growth, Git projects, and scheduled cron jobs, and provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and cockpit for Hermes agents and other coding-agent CLIs. It lets you search prompts, responses, tool activity, errors, and supported image references, resume supported sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp, and review per-session Codex and Claude quota burn.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted web dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, bringing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, session overview, cron management, system metrics, and agent status into one interface. It also provides real-time chat with streaming and tool-call visualization, MCP server lifecycle controls, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for running Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects a local Hermes agent to web dashboards through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox is designed for requests with side effects, making it a fit for workflows that need a review step.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing agent sessions. It also brings together a kanban board for agentic work and controls for profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a locally run, mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. Its features include terminal chat with streaming and file attachments, Telegram validation using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication, and background spawning for up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent packages Hermes as a Windows desktop app with a GUI and no-install, no-Docker, and no-admin-rights setup. It includes 100 tools across 20+ toolsets, supports cloud AI and local models through LM Studio, and provides a workflow engine with scheduling, conditions, loops, and parallel execution.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a self-hosted AI assistant interface with a glassmorphic design, chat, and real-time log streaming. It also includes a file browser and task-tracking dashboard, plus tools for managing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a process-monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes, with real-time session activity and cost tracking. It lets users inspect conversation histories and skill source code, while configuration and environment-variable views are read-only.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan UI is a self-hosted, chat-first AI workspace with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. Its marketplace supports discovering and installing skills and MCP servers, while isolated profiles keep sessions, memory, and API keys separate.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a native desktop client for multi-agent work, with streaming chat, model switching, and a PM orchestrator. It supports collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and includes a visual Skill Store with 50+ curated one-click installations.
